title: Plasma Insulin Measurement by ELISA
author: Henri Brunengraber
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.yesftee

steps.title: Collect plasma or serum
steps.instruction: Obtain plasma or serum from mice that are either fasted or have received a glucose injection, using heparin‑ or EDTA‑coated collection tubes.

substeps.instruction: Fast the mice or administer a glucose injection as required for the experiment.
Collect blood directly into heparin‑coated or EDTA‑coated tubes.
Centrifuge the tubes to separate plasma or allow clotting to obtain serum, then harvest the supernatant.

steps.title: Measure insulin by ELISA
steps.instruction: Determine insulin concentration using the Mouse Insulin ELISA Kit (96‑well plate, Cat. #10‑1247‑01) by following the manufacturer’s directions.
